human_tolerance.notes: Often visits gardens and may become very tame; takes sugar from bowls and bird feeders; builds nests in human-made objects such as lampshades and garden trellises.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: Wikipedia: the birds breed all year and build new nests throughout the year; no non-breeding phase is reported.

vocalizations.description: Short, varied warbling song given from a perch by both sexes; the species breeds all year and sings across the year (authored timing, see provenance).
Short chip-type alarm call given from a perch when disturbed (authored placeholder; no recording checked).

external.note: iNaturalist taxon 10199 via Wikidata P3151, checked against the iNaturalist taxa API on 2026-11-01.

conservation.note: Wikidata IUCN status item Q211005 (least concern); Wikipedia cites IUCN 3.1 LC.

range.note: Country list compiled from the Wikipedia distribution paragraph ('resident in tropical South America north to southern Mexico and the Caribbean ... found throughout the West Indies, except for Cuba') and the subspecies list, keeping only countries or territories named there. Not checked against a range map; BR is confirmed by named subspecies (e.g. minima, roraimae, alleni, chloropyga) and the species page.

traits.limb_count.note: Passerine bird: two legs, the schema convention for a perching songbird.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Flight is confirmed by the Wikipedia description; hopping is the usual passerine ground gait and is authored rather than stated in the source.

traits.flight.note: Powered flight; the species flies between perches.

traits.nest_type.note: Wikipedia describes a spherical lined nest with a side entrance hole, which has no exact enum value. 'Cup' is the nearest enum value; a domed nest is not a cup, so treat this field as a rendering approximation.

traits.perching.note: Wikipedia: 'While feeding, the bananaquit must perch, as it cannot hover'.

traits.mass_kg.note: Mass column 9.4 g for Coereba flaveola in row X=439 of the Scholer et al. 2020 dataset (CC0). The original mass source is not separately identified in the dataset, and Wikipedia gives a wider subspecies range of 5.5-19 g (see mass_range_kg).

traits.mass_range_kg.note: Wikipedia: weight ranges from 5.5 to 19 g across subspecies; converted to kg.

traits.length_m.note: Midpoint of the Wikipedia length range 10-13 cm (11.5 cm).

traits.lifespan_y.note: Proxy, not a measured wild lifespan. Mean remaining life after reaching adulthood under a constant annual adult survival phi, -1/ln(phi). phi = 0.647 (Johnston et al. 1997, via Scholer 2020 row X=439; SE 0.042; mark-recapture, Trinidad, 9 years). Result 2.30 years. Assumptions: constant survival, no juvenile-stage mortality term (first-year survival is not sourced, so the typical lifespan from fledging is not computed), and apparent survival, which emigration biases low, so this is a conservative adult-based proxy. Not a maximum or captive value.

traits.diet.note: Authored allocation. Wikipedia names nectar (primary), fruit including mistletoe fruit and bananas, and small insects, spiders and larvae, but gives no percentages. Values are a judgement that sums to 1.0; they are not measured.

traits.social.note: Authored judgement: Wikipedia describes territorial birds and nest building in pairs; no group-size source was checked. Feeding and roosting groups are not in the record.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Authored from the Wikipedia description of daytime feeding at flowers and gardens; no nocturnal activity is reported. Verify against a source with explicit diel timing if one is found.

traits.defense.note: Authored judgement: flight to cover from a threat, consistent with a small perching passerine.

traits.wariness.note: Judgement, low: Wikipedia says it may become very tame in gardens.

behavior.note: Local program bt-bananaquit-v1 (behavior.json): adapted from the shared perching-songbird program. Changes: nesting is not limited to April-May; song is by day rather than only at dawn and dusk; feeding is on nectar with a hop gait because the schema has no perch-feeding gait (the bird must perch to feed per Wikipedia). Limitation: the hop gait while feeding is an approximation.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Authored: shrub thicket as the roost and shelter, consistent with the wide open to semi-open habitat in the Wikipedia description.

habitat.use.note: Authored judgement from Wikipedia's open-to-semi-open habitat and perch-based feeding. Not a measured time budget.

habitat.resources.note: Tags follow the diet and nesting descriptions; weights are authored relative values, not measured.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Wikipedia: frequents gardens, becomes tame, feeds at feeders and sugar bowls, nests in human-made objects. light_max is an authored judgement.

seasonal.note: Wikipedia: resident in tropical South America; 'breed all year and build new nests throughout the year'. No migration is reported, so the strategy is ActiveYearRound with no dormancy phase.

vocalizations.note: Authored placeholder. No recording or description was checked. Replace with a licensed recording before relying on the call timing.

look.note: Authored look from the Wikipedia description: dark grey upperparts, black crown, white eyestripe, grey throat, yellow chest and belly. Not a measured colour value; the fine geometry is a stylisation.
